_comment: Sound requests for the audio generator (tools/audio). One entry per sound. 'variants' > 1 means produce name_1..name_N (similar but not identical). 'loop' sounds must loop seamlessly. 'dur' is a target length in seconds. 'bus' is the Godot bus the game plays it on. 'db' is the suggested base volume in dB for the game manifest. Style: low-fi 1990s office/hotel, restrained, never cartoonish; the horror is in what is slightly wrong.

sounds.name: amb_hum_bed
sounds.desc: Mains hum bed: 60 Hz fundamental plus 120/180/240 Hz harmonics, slow slight beating, very quiet air-handling noise floor. Dull, constant, institutional.

sounds.name: amb_buzz_cell
sounds.desc: Single fluorescent tube buzz: 120 Hz buzz with harmonics up to ~3 kHz, tiny irregular crackle, a little ballast whine. Played positionally per ceiling light.

sounds.name: amb_dark_pressure
sounds.desc: Low pressure tone for dark areas: lowpassed noise and a soft sub rumble, no melody.

sounds.name: amb_dread_drone
sounds.desc: Sub-bass drone with slowly beating detuned partials, slightly dissonant, no rhythm.

sounds.name: amb_heartbeat
sounds.desc: Single heartbeat cycle (lub-dub) at 60 bpm, muffled, lowpassed; the game varies pitch and speed.

sounds.name: amb_boiler_rumble
sounds.desc: Boiler room: deep furnace rumble, pipe ticking and distant steam hiss.

sounds.name: amb_pool_water
sounds.desc: Empty indoor pool: slow water lap, occasional drips with long tiled-room reverb.

sounds.name: amb_queue_whispers
sounds.desc: Many people whispering numbers very quietly, unintelligible, overlapping, dry paper-rustle bed.

sounds.name: amb_lobby_warm
sounds.desc: Grand hotel lobby room tone: warm, quiet, faint distant piano-like tones fading, clock tick.

sounds.name: muzak_elevator
sounds.desc: Bland elevator muzak, ~80 bpm: soft electric piano chords (maj7/min9), gentle bass, brushed noise percussion. Pleasant and slightly too slow; subtle tape wow.

sounds.name: elevator_hum
sounds.desc: Elevator cab motor hum with faint cable creak.

sounds.name: step_carpet
sounds.desc: Footstep on thin office carpet: muffled soft thump.

sounds.name: step_concrete
sounds.desc: Footstep on concrete: dry heel tap with short room tail.

sounds.name: step_tile
sounds.desc: Footstep on wet pool tile: slap with wet smear and echo.

sounds.name: step_water
sounds.desc: Footstep through shallow water: splash and drip.

sounds.name: step_metal
sounds.desc: Footstep on metal grating: hollow ring.

sounds.name: door_open
sounds.desc: Interior door opening: latch release then soft hinge creak.

sounds.name: door_close
sounds.desc: Interior door closing: swish then latch click.

sounds.name: door_creak
sounds.desc: Slow hinge creak, rising then falling pitch, unsettling.

sounds.name: door_handle_try
sounds.desc: Metal door handle slowly turned from the other side, stopping at the latch; one rattle.

sounds.name: door_brace_rattle
sounds.desc: Door being pushed against and rattling in its frame while held shut; thuds and metal rattle, building then fading.

sounds.name: door_locked
sounds.desc: Locked handle rattle, two short tries.

sounds.name: fire_door_bar
sounds.desc: Fire door push bar clunk and heavy door swing with echo.

sounds.name: wardrobe_open
sounds.desc: Wooden wardrobe door opening, soft wood creak.

sounds.name: wardrobe_close
sounds.desc: Wooden wardrobe door closing, dull wood thud.

sounds.name: locker_open
sounds.desc: Metal locker door opening with a ringing latch.

sounds.name: locker_close
sounds.desc: Metal locker door closing, hollow clang.

sounds.name: switch_click
sounds.desc: Wall switch click.

sounds.name: breaker_thunk
sounds.desc: Heavy breaker switch thrown: clunk plus transformer thud and electrical ring.

sounds.name: bulb_pop
sounds.desc: Fluorescent tube dying: sharp pop, short buzz stutter, a tick.

sounds.name: bulb_flicker
sounds.desc: Fluorescent tube starting up: flicker crackle then steady buzz onset.

sounds.name: bulb_insert
sounds.desc: Glass tube clicked into a fixture: pins seating, light tinkle.

sounds.name: bulb_remove
sounds.desc: Glass tube twisted out of a fixture.

sounds.name: pickup_item
sounds.desc: Small item picked up: cloth and plastic rustle.

sounds.name: drop_item
sounds.desc: Small item dropped on carpet: soft thump.

sounds.name: key_jingle
sounds.desc: A key and a plastic tag jingling.

sounds.name: battery_pickup
sounds.desc: Battery pack picked up: plastic clack and contact click.

sounds.name: box_slot
sounds.desc: Paper card slid into a suggestion box slot, a soft thunk inside.

sounds.name: card_flip
sounds.desc: Laminated card taken out and flipped: stiff plastic rustle.

sounds.name: notebook_page
sounds.desc: Notebook page turn.

sounds.name: stamp_thud
sounds.desc: Rubber stamp pressed on paper: dull thud.

sounds.name: pen_scratch
sounds.desc: Pen scratching a mark on paper.

sounds.name: ui_click
sounds.desc: Soft mechanical click for menu selection.

sounds.name: ui_back
sounds.desc: Softer, lower click for going back.

sounds.name: cam_raise
sounds.desc: Camcorder raised: motor whirr, plastic click, LCD power-up whine.

sounds.name: cam_lower
sounds.desc: Camcorder lowered: power-down whine falling.

sounds.name: cam_rec_beep
sounds.desc: Single short camcorder REC beep.

sounds.name: cam_lamp_click
sounds.desc: Camcorder lamp toggle click.

sounds.name: cam_tape_insert
sounds.desc: VHS-C tape loading into a camcorder: clunk, whirr, spool sync.

sounds.name: cam_playback_loop
sounds.desc: VHS playback: head-drum whir, tape hiss, faint tracking wobble.

sounds.name: cam_rewind_loop
sounds.desc: VHS rewind: higher pitched motor whirr with spool noise.

sounds.name: cam_freeze_shutter
sounds.desc: Freeze-frame snap: shutter click plus a short digital chirp.

sounds.name: cam_plant_thunk
sounds.desc: Camcorder set down on a floor: plastic thunk and rec beep.

sounds.name: cam_battery_low
sounds.desc: Camcorder low battery: three short beeps.

sounds.name: tape_glitch
sounds.desc: Short VHS tracking glitch: dropout noise burst and pitch squeal.

sounds.name: elevator_ding
sounds.desc: Elevator arrival chime: single clean two-note ding with long soft decay.

sounds.name: elevator_doors_open
sounds.desc: Elevator doors sliding open: metal glide, soft bump.

sounds.name: elevator_doors_close
sounds.desc: Elevator doors sliding closed: metal glide and soft thud.

sounds.name: elevator_start
sounds.desc: Elevator starting: motor engages, faint lurch, cable tension.

sounds.name: elevator_stop_wrong
sounds.desc: Elevator stops between floors: brake squeal and heavy clunk, then silence with distant echo.

sounds.name: ceiling_creak
sounds.desc: Something heavy shifting above the ceiling tiles: slow creak of wood and metal, a shower of tiny debris.

sounds.name: ceiling_tile_shift
sounds.desc: A ceiling tile lifted and set aside: dry scrape of fibreboard.

sounds.name: distant_door_close
sounds.desc: A door closing far away down a long hallway, with long reverb.

sounds.name: knock_slow
sounds.desc: Three slow, evenly spaced knocks on a wooden door (about a second apart), dry and close.

sounds.name: knock_irregular
sounds.desc: Three uneven knocks on a wooden door: short, long pause, quick double. Slightly off.

sounds.name: wrench_scrape_loop
sounds.desc: A heavy pipe wrench being dragged along concrete: rhythmic metal scrape with a clink every second.

sounds.name: alarm_loop
sounds.desc: Fire alarm bell ringing, harsh and loud, slightly muffled by distance.

sounds.name: whistle_blast
sounds.desc: Lifeguard whistle blast in a tiled hall, with long echo. Variant 2 is a little drier and lower.

sounds.name: water_ripple
sounds.desc: A single slow ripple of water lapping against a pool wall.

sounds.name: bell_ding
sounds.desc: Brass reception desk bell: single ding with ring.

sounds.name: cart_squeak_loop
sounds.desc: A linen cart pushed slowly: one wheel squeaks in a steady rhythm, rubber on carpet.

sounds.name: cart_stop
sounds.desc: The squeak of a cart wheel dying away as it stops, a little bump.

sounds.name: hum_drop
sounds.desc: Fluorescent hum dropping by a half-step in pitch and thinning; tell for the Hum entity.

sounds.name: hum_rise
sounds.desc: Fluorescent hum rising by a half-step and swelling; the inverted tell.

sounds.name: queue_chime
sounds.desc: Now-serving chime: two soft electronic notes, then a mechanical click of a number board flipping.

sounds.name: greeter_bell
sounds.desc: Small hotel hand-bell, two dings, polite.

sounds.name: hit_thud
sounds.desc: Muffled body impact thump plus a fast low sweep; not violent, disorienting.

sounds.name: blackout_whoomp
sounds.desc: Low impact then fading tinnitus tone: the sound of losing consciousness.

sounds.name: tinnitus_ring
sounds.desc: High pure tone ring that fades slowly.

sounds.name: stinger_low
sounds.desc: Low dissonant string-like swell that cuts off abruptly; used rarely.

sounds.name: whisper_numbers
sounds.desc: A close whisper counting numbers, unintelligible, a breath at the end.

sounds.name: pa_chime
sounds.desc: Two-tone PA chime (descending major third), soft, in a large room.

sounds.name: pa_click_on
sounds.desc: Microphone/PA channel opening: click and a breath of hiss.

sounds.name: pa_click_off
sounds.desc: PA channel closing: click and hiss cut.

sounds.name: static_burst
sounds.desc: A short burst of PA static and feedback squeal.

sounds.name: mic_pop
sounds.desc: A very quiet low microphone plosive pop (about 80 Hz thump); layered under the first word of a lie. Barely audible.
